b.answer:
Worked example: a typed Harvest Lane sample invoice from "Green Basket", saved as a PDF, read by a provider AI module with the 2.7 prompt, then JSON · Parse JSON with a data structure generated from the playground's clean sample.

{
  "supplier": "Green Basket",
  "invoice_number": "GB-044",
  "invoice_date": "2026-10-14",
  "currency": "NGN",
  "lines": [
    { "description": "Cucumber, crate", "qty": 4, "unit_price": 7500, "line_total": 30000 },
    { "description": "Carrots, bag", "qty": 6, "unit_price": 5000, "line_total": 30000 },
    { "description": "Ugwu leaves, bundle", "qty": 20, "unit_price": 500, "line_total": 10000 }
  ],
  "subtotal": 70000, "vat": 5250, "total": 75250,
  "unreadable_parts": []
}

Checker: AUTO-SAVE. Each line multiplies out; 30,000 + 30,000 + 10,000 = 70,000; 70,000 + 5,250 = 75,250.

Prompt fix along the way: the first run returned "₦70,000" as text. Adding "numbers without ₦ or commas" to the rules fixed it. After parsing, supplier, total and lines[] all appear as mappable fields.
mistakes: Skipping Parse JSON, so the AI's reply is one long text field and nothing maps.
Leaving ₦ signs or commas in the numbers, so the checker can't do the arithmetic.
Using a real supplier's invoice instead of a typed sample.
Writing a sample invoice whose own numbers don't add up, then blaming the prompt.
b.pass: The checker says AUTO-SAVE for the AI's output, and a screenshot shows supplier, total and the lines array as mappable fields after Parse JSON.
b.redo: Send it back if the checker flags any rule, if fields aren't mappable, or if the invoice contains real supplier or bank details.

s.answer:
Worked example: Harvest Lane's invoice pipeline with five sample invoices typed or written by hand (no real supplier data).

InvoiceTypeRouteWhy
Farmgate FG-0192PDFAuto-saveLines 290,000; + VAT 21,750 = 311,750 ✓
Green Basket GB-044Phone photo of a printoutAuto-save70,000 + 5,250 = 75,250 ✓
Ibadan Onion Co. IOC-311PDF, no VATAuto-save40 × 3,000 = 120,000; VAT 0 (note for Tolu, not an error)
PackRight PR-118PDF, deliberately wrong totalReviewsubtotal 80,000 + VAT 6,000 = 86,000, but total says 96,000
Mama Bisi FarmPhoto, handwrittenReviewinvoice_number null; unreadable_parts: "line 1 quantity, second digit"

Router filter on Auto-save (all AND): bad-lines text is empty; abs(sum - subtotal) <= 1; abs(subtotal + vat - total) <= 1; invoice_number exists; length(unreadable_parts) = 0. Fallback goes to Needs_Review.

Needs_Review row for PR-118: supplier PackRight Ltd · reason "subtotal + VAT = 86,000 but total = 96,000" · Drive link · status New. Tolu got one email per review item with the same reason.

The AI module has an error handler: alert, then Break with two retries. Bubble counts for the run: Drive 5 · AI 5 · Parse 5 · Iterator 13 lines · Auto-save route 3 · Review route 2.

Submit: the route table, screenshots of Supplier_Invoices, Invoice_Lines and Needs_Review, and the provider's token cost for the five invoices.
mistakes: Routing on the AI's total alone, with no line or subtotal check, so the wrong-total invoice is saved.
Letting the model guess a missing invoice number instead of returning null, so the handwritten slip auto-saves.
Review rows with no reason or no Drive link, so Tolu can't act on them.
Treating a supplier with no VAT as an error instead of a note.
s.pass: Five sample invoices, including a photo and a wrong total, each show their route and reason; the wrong-total and unclear invoices are in Needs_Review with correct reasons, and clean ones are saved automatically.
s.redo: Send it back if a bad invoice auto-saved, if a clean one went to review without a real reason, or if the AI step has no error handler.

g.answer:
Worked example: Harvest Lane's read-only "Ask Weave" agent.

System prompt: "You answer Tolu's questions about supplier spending using only the tools provided. Never change data. If the tools can't answer, say so. Give amounts in naira with the invoice numbers you used."

Tool (scenario)InputsReturnsWrites?
HL · Spend lookupsupplier, product, date_from, date_tototal, invoice count, invoice numbers (Search Rows on Invoice_Lines + numeric aggregator)No
HL · Supplier listnonesupplier names and categoriesNo

Trigger: Telegram messages from Tolu's chat ID only (filter), thread ID = chat ID.

#QuestionManual checkAgentOK
1Tomatoes from Farmgate in October?₦540,000, 3 invoices₦540,000 (FG-0188, FG-0192, FG-0197)✓
2Total spend with Ibadan Onion Co. in October?₦360,000₦360,000✓
3How many invoices from Green Basket this month?22✓
4Biggest supplier by spend in October?FarmgateFarmgate✓
5Onions bought 1–15 Oct?₦120,000₦120,000✓
6Did tatashe prices rise since September?6,000 → 6,5006,000 in Sept, 6,500 in Oct✓
7Packaging spend in October?₦86,000₦80,000 (left out VAT)✗
8Which suppliers do we use for produce?4 names4 names✓
9What was our profit in October?Not in the data"I can't answer: I only see supplier spending."✓ honest
10Will Farmgate raise prices next month?Not in the data"I can't predict that from the invoices."✓ honest

Score: 9 of 10 match. Fix for #7: tool output now labels totals as "incl. VAT". Credits: copy the total for the 10 questions from the scenario history, plus the provider's token cost. Neither tool can add, update or delete a row.
mistakes: Giving the agent a tool that can update or delete rows, even "just for clean-up".
Writing all ten questions so the data can answer them, with no test of honest refusals.
Marking answers correct without a manual check against the sheet.
Leaving the Telegram trigger open to anyone, not just Tolu's chat ID.
g.pass: The ten-question table shows at least 8 answers matching a manual check, honest "can't answer" replies to both unanswerable questions, the credits used, and tool settings proving nothing can change data.
g.redo: Send it back if fewer than 8 answers match, if the agent invented an answer to an unanswerable question, or if any tool writes or deletes.
